intro.fr: YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- se joue en multiworld Archipelago grâce à un APWorld communautaire, distribué hors de l'installation officielle.
intro.en: YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- can be played in an Archipelago multiworld through a community APWorld, distributed outside the official install.

text.fr: Inti Creates sort YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- en 2023.
text.en: Inti Creates releases YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- in 2023.

text.en: The first version, yohane_bitdb-v0.0.1 (pre-release), is released.

text.fr: Publication de la version yohane_bitdb-v0.2.5, la plus récente des 15 versions au nom du jeu sur ce dépôt au 21 octobre 2026.
text.en: Version yohane_bitdb-v0.2.5 is released, the latest of the 15 versions named after the game on this repository as of October 21, 2026.

text.fr: YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- figure dans le tableur communautaire des APWorlds, qui recense les mondes jouables hors de l'installation officielle d'Archipelago.
text.en: YOHANE THE PARHELION -BLAZE in the DEEPBLUE- is listed in the community APWorlds spreadsheet, which tracks the worlds playable outside the official Archipelago install.
